capacity_gross_kwh.notes: Hyundai Canada states 84.0 kWh for the Preferred Long Range RWD only; assumed to be the same Long Range pack.

nominal_voltage_class.notes: Battery voltage 697 V (Australian-market sheet; same pack).

chemistry.notes: Estimated: page lists the 84 kWh E-GMP pack (2025 IONIQ 5 Long Range/XRT) as SK On NCM 811 pouch; EV Database also says NMC for the 84 kWh IONIQ 5. Hyundai Canada only says lithium-ion.

capacity_usable_kwh.notes: European listing of the same 84 kWh pack (MY24): 80.0 kWh usable. Pack is shared across markets.

preconditioning.notes: Estimated: the US 2026 owner's manual page (code NE1a) describes manual plus navigation-automatic Battery Conditioning; the page does not name the model, NE1 being the IONIQ 5 platform code (inference). No Canadian manual read.

ac_max_kw.notes: US page: home charging up to 10.9 kW. Hyundai Canada page does not state it. EV Database lists 11 kW for the European car.

dc_max_kw.notes: US 2025 first drive relays a "peak rate of 257 kW" on a 350 kW CCS charger (Hyundai US figure; Wikipedia infobox also 257). Conflicts: EV Database 263 kW (Hyundai Europe claims 260 kW), Wikipedia spec table 238 kW, Car and Driver measured about 258 kW. Estimated for 2026: same hardware as the 2025 car; no charging change reported.
